title: Product Delivery
summary: Explicitly activated provider-neutral delivery workflow with one living Implementation Plan, implementer self-review, and fresh independent verification.

roles.title: Product Partner
roles.summary: Optional discovery and product-alignment specialist. Use for broad or ambiguous product goals or a product-alignment review; contributes to the shared Implementation Plan and hands ownership to the Delivery Lead.

roles.title: Delivery Lead
roles.summary: Default entry point and accountable task owner. Use to clarify the request, investigate the real codebase, own the living Implementation Plan, implement authorized work, delegate, integrate, and self-verify.

roles.title: Verifier
roles.summary: Fresh independent evidence-oriented reviewer. Use proactively after implementation to check the actual change against the Implementation Plan's authorized criteria and decisions, and to report passed, failed, unverified, and skipped checks with evidence.
